evidence_budget: one staging row + one evidence artifact per claim; trim raw dumps to verdict-supporting fields.
exclusion: E1: individual-level outcomes, even when the title names the topic.
E3: duplicate identifiers (keep first by keep-order).
inclusion: I1: studies that test or discuss the topic against outcomes measured at the work-unit level (unit, division, branch, or organization acting as a unit), with data.

verification_contract.layer1: doi.org/<ID> must end HTTP 200 at the article landing page with article markers; challenge, login, or empty bodies fail.
verification_contract.layer2: api.crossref.org/works/<ID> title + year must match the candidate.
